30A Escapes presents… “Dock 'N Dune”, a 5-bedroom lakefront home in Seagrove Beach, perfect for family getaways or friend reunions. Wake up to Eastern Lake views, relax by your private seasonally heated pool and spa, or enjoy Gulf views just a 3-min walk from the beach. With space for 20 guests, 7 bikes, and access to 30A trails, shops, and charm, this home blends adventure and relaxation. From sunrise coffees on the dock to evenings filled with laughter, your unforgettable escape awaits. Learn more below...👇

★☆ HIGHLIGHTS ☆★

✔ Lakefront Living: Enjoy serene mornings and peaceful evenings with stunning views of Eastern Lake from multiple decks and your own private dock—a true escape into nature’s tranquility.
✔ Gulf Views: Experience breathtaking sunsets from the rooftop deck, where every evening feels like a postcard-perfect moment.
✔ Private Seasonally Heated Pool and Spa: Relax in ultimate luxury with a seasonally heated pool and spa overlooking the lake—perfect for unwinding after a day of adventure.
✔ Steps to the Beach: Just a short 3-minute walk to 2 beach access points, making it easy to sink your toes into the sand and soak up the sun.
✔ Room for Everyone: With 5 spacious bedrooms, including fun bunk areas, this home is designed for large groups or families to connect and create lasting memories.
✔ Outdoor Entertainment: Gather around the fire pit for s’mores, enjoy a BBQ feast, or simply relax in the ample outdoor seating—perfect for lively evenings under the stars.
✔ 7 Bikes Included: Explore the charm of 30A trails or nearby Seaside with ease, adding a touch of adventure to your stay.

Eager to Read More?
Here Are a Few Kind Words from Our Guests:

⭐ "Fantastic views and a perfect location! Our kids (ages 21 to 4 years) loved walking to the beach and enjoying the lake. Breathtaking panoramic views from the 4th floor! We fished, kayaked, and surfed the waves." – August B.
⭐ "Great location and plenty of space for our family! Would highly recommend for a relaxing stay near the beach." – Amir R.
⭐ "Beautiful home with lots of space and attentive management. Loved the short walk to the beach and the included bikes!" – Maegan K.

★☆ LIVING AREA ☆★

Unwind in ultimate comfort with thoughtfully designed spaces perfect for connection and entertainment. The main living room features luxurious, plush seating, a cozy sitting area ideal for quiet moments, and expansive windows that showcase breathtaking, panoramic lake views.

✔ Expansive main living area featuring plush, comfortable sofas bathed in natural light
✔ Cozy separate sitting nook, perfect for reading, relaxing, or intimate conversations
✔ Stunning lakefront balcony with high-top seating, ideal for enjoying sunset drinks and breathtaking views

★☆ KITCHEN AND DINING ☆★

Create culinary masterpieces in the state-of-the-art chef’s kitchen, complete with premium stainless-steel appliances, double ovens, a spacious gas range, and all the tools you need to elevate your cooking. The elegant dining area offers ample seating for your entire group, setting the perfect stage for unforgettable meals and cherished moments.

✔ Premium stainless-steel appliances, featuring a high-performance gas range and double ovens for all your cooking needs
✔ Spacious dining table with seating for 8, complemented by 4 stylish barstools at the center island for casual gatherings
✔ Private balcony with stunning lake views, equipped with a propane grill for unforgettable al fresco dining experiences

★☆ OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ☆★

Transform your outdoor space into a true paradise with a private seasonally heated pool and spa for ultimate relaxation, a fire pit perfect for cozy, starlit evenings, and an exclusive dock where you can fish or kayak the tranquil, crystal-clear waters of Eastern Lake.

✔ Luxurious seasonally heated pool and spa overlooking serene lakefront views—your private oasis awaits
✔ Propane barbecue grill for outdoor cooking and dining with family and friends
✔ Cozy fire pit area with ample seating, ideal for stargazing nights or roasting marshmallows with loved ones
✔ Exclusive private dock perfect for fishing, kayaking, or relaxing under the sun in complete tranquility

★☆ BEDROOMS AND BATHROOMS ☆★

Each bedroom seamlessly blends comfort and elegance, offering a serene retreat for guests. With plush, luxurious bedding and thoughtfully designed interiors, every room provides a haven of relaxation. Guests can enjoy the added luxury of private balconies or take in breathtaking lakeside views, creating an unforgettable stay.

1st Floor
✔ Bunk Room: Custom-built Queen-over-Queen bunk beds and a Twin daybed, offering direct access to the pool and patio for ultimate convenience and relaxation.
✔ Guest Suite: Luxurious King bed with a private En-suite bathroom, a handy kitchenette, and direct pool access—perfect for guests seeking privacy and comfort.

2nd Floor
✔ Powder Room and Mudroom: Equipped with a washer and dryer for effortless convenience, all strategically located to keep things tidy and accessible.

3rd Floor
✔ Primary Suite: Indulge in a King bed with a private balcony offering breathtaking Gulf views. The En-suite features double vanities, a soaking tub, and a spacious walk-in shower for a spa-like retreat.
✔ Two King Guest Bedrooms: Both rooms feature King beds, a shared En-suite bathroom, and private lakefront balconies for tranquil mornings with stunning views.

4th Floor
✔ Bunk Area: Twin-over-Full bunk bed, perfect for kids or extra guests, alongside a spectacular wraparound balcony. Enjoy panoramic views that make this space truly unforgettable.

★☆ LOCATION AND COMMUNITY ☆★

Dock ’N Dune is ideally located in the heart of Seagrove Beach, offering the perfect blend of natural beauty and coastal charm. Surrounded by tranquil lakes, sugar-white beaches, and 30A’s renowned attractions, it’s a haven for relaxation and adventure. Take a leisurely stroll to nearby local restaurants, charming boutique shops, or visit the iconic Seaside for vibrant entertainment and unforgettable experiences.

✔ Seagrove Beach Access Points - Just a 3-minute walk away, you’ll find easy access to pristine beaches where you can unwind and enjoy the sound of crashing waves.
✔ Old Florida Fish House - A 4-minute ride takes you to this laid-back spot, perfect for enjoying fresh seafood and soaking up the quintessential coastal charm.
✔ Eastern Lake - Access serene coastal dune lake right of your back door, ideal for fishing, kayaking, and paddleboarding in a peaceful, natural setting.
✔ Seaside Beach - Just a 10-minute drive away, this iconic beach town offers white sandy shores, unique shops, and a vibrant, relaxed atmosphere that feels straight out of a movie.

★☆ OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ☆★

✔ To ensure a smooth and secure stay, guests are required to complete the 30A Escapes Rental Agreement after booking. This agreement outlines important house rules and helps us provide the best experience possible. Once your reservation is confirmed, you will receive a link via the booking platform to sign the agreement. After it is completed, we will send your official booking confirmation email with all the details you need. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us directly – we are always happy to help!
✔ Travel insurance is NOT included in your quote. It can be purchased upon booking, added to your reservation by the final payment date, or obtained independently.
✔ We do NOT accept wire transfers for payment. (AMEX, Visa, and MasterCard ONLY)
✔ This property has 7 bikes for guest use. To utilize the bikes, a waiver must be signed before the code is provided to the guest. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.
✔ Pool can be heated between September 1st and April 30th.
✔ There is an active Ring doorbell camera at the entrance door of the home.
✔ The indoor fireplace and the garage are not for guest use.
✔ There is active construction taking place next door with an unknown completion date. There is also active construction around the corner that can be seen from the backyard and balconies with an unknown completion date.

☆★ YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ☆★

At 30A Escapes, we are committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.

★☆ BOOK TODAY AND START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ☆★
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
